description: Design, build, or refactor websites in the Celebration Commerce language, derived from the public-facing SendCards.Store design system. Use for make utility feel like anticipation: soft orbital paths, gift-like color, confident scheduling, and clear trust around money and delivery. Includes narrative guidance, design tokens, page structure, a responsive static starter, safe scaffolding, and publication checks. Adapt the system to the user's brand instead of cloning names, logos, copy, or proprietary content.
